notes: From webJPEG/README.md measured-performance table; Recv/Total(with network)/duration/gaps not recorded there, left blank rather than estimated.

Only a "~150-250ms render step" range was ever recorded (see webRAW-CYD README) - no separate decode/push split, no fps/drop-rate/duration data exists. total_min_ms/total_max_ms hold that range; compute_total_avg_ms deliberately left blank rather than inventing a midpoint.
raw_live_capture.txt. Very short window (3.44s) right after a forced device reset - low sample size, no ack-recovery fix present yet (predates it) but happened not to hit a stall.

raw_live_capture2.txt. Predates the ack-nudge/watchdog fix. 4 multi-second gaps (2142/8278/4763/6038ms) = ~48% dead time in this window, from a delayed device ack stalling the browser with no recovery path - see webRAW-CYD README Troubleshooting.

raw_live_capture3.txt. After the ack-nudge (device) + watchdog (browser) fix - zero gaps >500ms across 113.85s. decode_decompress_avg_ms/prep_avg_ms blank because this firmware logs one combined "Decompress+Push" stage (TFT_eSPI handles the byte-swap internally via setSwapBytes(true), no separate manual step) - see compute_total_avg_ms instead.

amoled_stream_capture.txt. High drop rate (69.8%) is the expected Immediate-mode signature (unpaced sending). The one gap >500ms (11.4s) was a real WS client disconnect/reconnect, not a stall - see README.

amoled_measure1.txt. Ack-paced - drop rate down to 15% from Immediate mode's 69.8%. All gaps >500ms stayed under 650ms (minor jitter, not the multi-second stalls the ack-recovery fix targets - confirms that fix carries over to this board).
